insight: Founded in 2022 and backed by about $8M; its document-parsing/OCR API was reworked into a sandbox cloud for agents.
name: Tensorlake
description: Tensorlake is a cloud platform that gives AI agents their own isolated, stateful sandboxes for running code and calling tools safely. Each sandbox is a microVM that can pause and resume, so long-running agentic loops keep their state across restarts and can run for hours. It exposes serverless Python workflow APIs that scale to zero when idle, and its earlier document-parsing and OCR API now runs as one workload on top. A free tier is available.

modelSupport.notes: Infrastructure layer — runs any agent's or model's code and tool calls.

edge: Sandboxes are stateful microVMs that pause and resume, so a long agent loop survives restarts instead of losing state on ephemeral runners.
cons: Self-host only on the enterprise tier
